svg.text: ResearchAgent — before the sprint vs. what is on main now
Left: September hackathon prototype (b2a71ed). Right: Oct-10 build (8937da6, 17 PRs). Green ①–⑤ = the five hard gates from prompt.md §2.
BEFORE · one monolith, human clicks every step
src/App.tsx — 581 lines, one component + research-plan.ts wizard
every pink head = a manual click; the browser drives the run
server/index.ts — 465 lines: routes + state + pay + LLM
deps: express · react · zod · xrpl storage: JSON file tests: 6 files, mostly UI flow
AFTER · three processes, the server drives the loop
Vite + React · renders server snapshots + SSE only · src/components/*
one async runner per run · ≤3 rounds
span text must be an exact substring of a delivered body (L1 + L3)
node:sqlite · data/app.db · BEGIN IMMEDIATE budget + cap check
Zod schemas (corpus · publisher · ledger · answer · decision · report · run) shared by web, api and tests
repeat ≤3 rounds · 1 buy per round · stops when nothing clears the bar, budget is spent, or Stop
Who can cause money to move
injected text reaches the thing that chooses
no path: the LLM only writes
retry-delivery: same receipt, no new charge
restart while SUBMITTING → reconcile via GET /v1/settlements/:intentId (publisher journal is idempotent per intent)
Where you are → where to push
skip: Cloud Run publisher (first in cut order)
gates: ① no premium bytes before grant ② budget is the only authority ③ one charge per intent ④ real citations ⑤ fallbacks labelled
